Os.Caption: Microsoft Windows 11 专业工作站版

method.default: 3 alternating-order process repetitions per variant; 512 frames each, discard first 256.
method.scenarios: 2 reversed-order repetitions per variant; 384 frames each, discard first 192. Dynamic scenes use wall clock, not fixed replay.
method.wall: CPU render-loop elapsed time including admission, events, game wait, preparation, recording/submission and present call. Hidden window, no VSync, 1280x720, three frames in flight. Not scanout latency or GPU timestamp frame duration.
method.instrumentation: Release copies of RuntimeApplication.cs and FrameExecutor.cs; preallocated runtime rows, small per-frame graph measurement rows. No console/file writes in timed loop. Baseline uses neither validation, frame-output readback, graph diagnostics, RenderDoc nor EventPipe.
method.gpu: Fresh RenderDoc 1.43 capture at frame 100, runtime exits before replay; seven EventGPUDuration replays. Event totals are not async frame wall times.
method.memory: Distinct heaps referenced by latest allocations of each of three frame states; classify Heap.Info.MemoryType. Does not include every idle heap, persistent resources, RHI allocations or WDDM residency.

sparseRanges.Method: 64 readers, 1 or 128 disjoint ranges, 16 warmup frames, 48 measured frames, four alternating repetitions. CPU execution includes submission and state commit; GPU wait is outside the measured interval. Allocation is on the calling thread only; validation is disabled.
